def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]; n=len(g)
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if g[i][j]==8]
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            val=None
            for si,sj in [(31-i,j),(i,31-j),(31-i,31-j)]:
                if 0<=si<n and 0<=sj<n and g[si][sj]!=8:
                    val=g[si][sj]; break
            if val is None: val=4  # fallback: neighbor-continuity guess at free border
            row.append(val)
        out.append(row)
